messages:
Ava (CS Ops): quick ask — compiling a short harvest of verbatim customer lines from this week's onboarding cohort. please paste the exact sentence, add a tag (friction|integration|billing|performance|ux), impact (go-live|support-burden|ops-cost), and a quick priority (P0/P1/P2).
Marta (PM): copying into product signals. short is fine but verbatim helps repro.
Ravi (Onboarding): got three from calls today:
• "Our user IDs don't line up between tools, we have to do manual joins every week." tag: integration; impact: support-burden; prio: P1
• "When we upload long transcripts the editor times out." tag: performance; impact: go-live; prio: P0
• "Default onboarding docs assume a Postgres schema, we run everything in BigQuery." tag: integration; impact: ops-cost; prio: P2
Marta (PM): nice. Ravi — can you paste the verbatim of the editor timeout error if you have it? stack trace or console text helps.
Ravi (Onboarding): paste from notes: "Editing the transcript fails after ~30s with a 504. We had to chop files into 5 parts to save." tag: performance; impact: go-live; prio: P0
Ava (CS Ops): added rows to the shared harvest sheet: https://docs.google.com/sheets/d/harvest-2026. please add column 'account_health' and set (onboarded|trial|renewal_risk). i'll tag the ones flagged renewal_risk for follow-up.
Jon (Eng): for the editor timeout — what's the avg doc size and tokens? and were users on mobile or desktop?
Ravi (Onboarding): avg doc ~150KB, ~18k tokens, desktop. customer is on trial, low qps.
Marta (PM): small ask — mark repeats as 'cluster' in the sheet so we can roll multiple accounts into single engineering tickets.
Ava (CS Ops): agreed. i'm sketching a short triage rubric: P0 = blocks go-live or renewal at risk, P1 = creates regular support burden or workarounds, P2 = enhancement/nice-to-have.
Ravi (Onboarding): another verbatim: "The agent suggestions are noisy — we get lots of false matches for entity linking which wastes ops time." tag: friction; impact: support-burden; prio: P1
Marta (PM): thanks. i'll queue the P0s for Wed product sync and add an evaluation prompt set so reviewers can reproduce.
FeedbackBot: Reminder — please finish adding outstanding quotes by EOD tomorrow.
Jon (Eng): if you see multiple integration asks with BigQuery, put them in the same cluster and note sample schemas in the sheet. i'll look at possible schema-mapping helpers.
Ava (CS Ops): pinging a couple of accounts to clarify wording; will update rows with account_health and add 'sample_payload' where customers shared logs. :thumbsup:
Marta (PM): perfect — we'll use clusters + impact to prioritize rollups for the next sprint. :rocket:
